title: Cross-document synthesis from four notes
objective: Measure whether the corpus-synthesis craftbook reads every document, organizes by theme, cites sources, and surfaces contradictions.
prompt: In the `Corpus Synthesis Eval` project, read every file under `source/corpus/` and write `tasks/eval/synthesis.md` answering: what should HarborCRM change before expanding guided returns intake? Organize by theme, cite sources [1]-[4], surface contradictions/open questions, and do not write a file-by-file summary. Use only facts from the four seeded notes. Do not invent inventory systems, product defects, return-rate targets, accounting treatments, SLA durations, or operational details beyond the corpus.

setup.about: Self-contained eval project for corpus-synthesis. Four short source documents are in workspace/source/corpus.
setup.missionObjectives: Synthesize all seeded documents into a thematic answer with source citations, contradictions, and open questions.

files.content: [1] Support notes: Guided intake reduced repetitive questions, but status silence after photo submission is now the top complaint. Agents want auto-status emails and clearer reason codes.
[2] Warehouse notes: barcode exceptions slow return processing. Training is needed before national rollout. Monday mornings breach SLA when photo review queue is full.
[3] Finance notes: refund leakage fell from 14.2% to 8.9%, but Finance requires a weekly exception export before approving automation.
[4] Product notes: West warehouse expansion is preferred for 30 days. Product wants to defer national rollout until exports are reliable, while Sales wants a July national launch.

success.summary: workspace/synthesis.md is organized by theme, cites all four source docs, surfaces contradictions/open questions, and avoids per-file summaries.

checks.pattern: status silence[\s\S]{0,400}auto-status emails|auto-status emails[\s\S]{0,400}status silence|reason codes
checks.label: include support status-silence and auto-status/reason-code needs
include warehouse barcode training or Monday SLA risk
include Finance weekly exception export approval dependency
include the 30-day West warehouse expansion recommendation
surface Product vs Sales rollout tension

checks.pattern: PLM|resalable|restocking fees|warranty budget|target return rate|defect rate|returned goods inventory|dynamic fee|slotting|inventory management|SLA[^\n]{0,120}30 days|30 days[^\n]{0,120}SLA
checks.label: do not invent systems, accounting treatments, defect metrics, or SLA durations beyond the seeded corpus

axes.name: accuracy
axes.description: Computed figures are correct against the seeded records.

axes.name: grounding
axes.description: Every claim traces to the seeded data — nothing invented.

axes.name: structure
axes.description: Tables and sections make the analysis checkable at a glance.

axes.name: actionability
axes.description: Recommendations follow from the findings and are concretely doable.
